hunks.baseline: If that was what it took to earn a place among the Ten Kings, just how formidable was the Sword Saint, whose name ranked ahead of his?
hunks.sol: If that was what it took to become one of the Ten Kings, just how formidable was the Sword Saint, whose name ranked ahead of his?

hunks.baseline: Beans grow where beans are planted. A monster had raised a monster.
hunks.sol: You reap what you sow. A monster had raised a monster.

hunks.baseline: “Urk, uweeek!”
hunks.sol: “Urk, bleeegh!”

hunks.baseline: I asked Cheongpung, who continued retching.
hunks.sol: I asked Cheongpung, who was still retching, “Are you all right?”

hunks.baseline: “Are you all right?”
“You’re clearly not all right.”
hunks.sol: “You’re clearly not.”

hunks.baseline: “More importantly, Senior looks badly hurt, ugh!”
hunks.sol: “More importantly, Senior looks badly hurt, bleegh!”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t call me Senior. I’m fine. A little spit and this much will heal right up.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t call him Senior. He’s fine. A little spit and that’ll heal right up.”

hunks.baseline: I patted Cheongpung on the back and glanced around. Everyone except Hong Jin was staring at us with wide eyes.
hunks.sol: I patted Cheongpung on the back and glanced around. Everyone except Hong Jin was staring at us wide-eyed.

hunks.baseline: Gong Ilhyuk’s reaction stood out more than anyone else’s. He had apparently forgotten his pain and was staring blankly at Cheongpung before suddenly shouting.
hunks.sol: Gong Ilhyuk’s reaction stood out most of all. Apparently forgetting his pain, he stared blankly at Cheongpung before suddenly shouting.

hunks.baseline: “Nonsense! The Sword Saint has been in seclusion for more than thirty years! How dare a piece of trash like you claim to be the Sword Saint’s heir?”
hunks.sol: “Nonsense! The Sword Saint has been in seclusion for more than thirty years! How dare someone like you claim to be the Sword Saint’s heir?”

hunks.baseline: “Excuse me for interrupting.”
hunks.sol: “Sorry to interrupt.”

hunks.baseline: “Why don’t you stop the bleeding first? You’re losing a lot of blood.”
hunks.sol: “Why don’t you stop the bleeding first? You’re losing an awful lot of blood.”

hunks.baseline: Gong Ilhyuk’s face turned bright red. He had to be embarrassed. His arm had been shattered with a single blow, yet he was still calling someone else a piece of trash.
hunks.sol: Gong Ilhyuk’s face turned bright red. He had to be embarrassed. His arm had been shattered in one blow, yet he was still talking about “someone like you.”

hunks.baseline: “Tch. If only I hadn’t let my guard down…”
hunks.sol: “If only I hadn’t let my guard down…”

hunks.baseline: “Then shall we arrange a rematch once you’ve recovered? I can lend you my family’s training hall.”
hunks.sol: “Then shall we arrange a rematch once you’ve recovered? I can lend you my family’s training ground.”

hunks.baseline: Even if they fought a hundred times, Gong Ilhyuk would lose all hundred. The difference between the two of them was that obvious.
hunks.sol: Even if they fought a hundred times, Gong Ilhyuk would lose all hundred. The gap between them was that obvious.

hunks.baseline: The proof was that, now that I had actually offered him the chance, Gong Ilhyuk went silent as though he had swallowed honey.
hunks.sol: Sure enough, the moment I offered to set it up, Gong Ilhyuk clammed up.

hunks.baseline: “Stop the bleeding first. Stop the bleeding.”
hunks.sol: “Stop the bleeding first. The bleeding.”

hunks.baseline: “……You bastard.”
hunks.sol: “…You bastard.”

hunks.baseline: Gong Ilhyuk glared at me with murderous eyes.
hunks.sol: Gong Ilhyuk glared at me murderously.

hunks.baseline: It seemed he had finally realized that I disliked him, but I didn’t feel particularly threatened.
hunks.sol: It seemed he had finally realized I disliked him, but I didn’t feel particularly threatened.

hunks.baseline: If word of what happened today got out, they were the ones who would suffer. They had gotten entangled with the Sword Saint’s grandson, and even the Sect Leader of the Zhongnan Sect—Gong Ilhyuk’s father’s cousin—wouldn’t be happy about that.
hunks.sol: If word of what happened today got out, they were the ones who would suffer. They had picked a fight with the Sword Saint’s grandson, and even the Sect Leader of the Zhongnan Sect—Gong Ilhyuk’s father’s cousin—wouldn’t be pleased about that.

hunks.baseline: Meanwhile, I wasn’t even directly involved. I had also gained an unexpected golden connection.
hunks.sol: Meanwhile, I wasn’t even directly involved, and I had gained an unexpected golden connection.

hunks.baseline: *Listen here, I gave the Sword Saint’s grandson candied hawthorn skewers[^1], took him to the hot springs, and did it all, okay? You bastard.*
hunks.sol: *Listen, asshole. I gave the Sword Saint’s grandson candied hawthorn skewers[^1], took him to the hot springs—the works.*

hunks.baseline: So this was how the candied-hawthorn stock took off.
hunks.sol: So this was how candied-hawthorn stock went through the roof.

hunks.baseline: I was smiling inwardly when Gong Ilhyuk finished stopping the bleeding and sneered.
hunks.sol: I was smiling inwardly when Gong Ilhyuk finished staunching the bleeding and sneered.

hunks.baseline: “The entire world knows that the Sword Saint devoted his entire life to martial arts! You’re obviously lying!”
hunks.sol: “The entire world knows that the Sword Saint devoted his life to martial arts! You’re clearly lying!”

hunks.baseline: *What the fuck was that supposed to mean now?*
hunks.sol: *What the fuck was that supposed to mean?*

hunks.baseline: As everyone’s attention turned toward him, Cheongpung looked back at me with a confused expression.
hunks.sol: As everyone’s attention turned toward him, Cheongpung looked at me in confusion.

hunks.baseline: “What exactly do you know?”
hunks.sol: “What exactly do you think you know?”

hunks.baseline: “About cranes bringing babies. Grandfather told me that babies are chosen by Heaven, and when the time comes, a crane delivers them.”
hunks.sol: “That cranes bring babies. Grandfather told me babies are chosen by Heaven, and when the time comes, a crane delivers them.”

hunks.baseline: “Well, that’s…”
hunks.sol: “Well, you see…”

hunks.baseline: I continued with a heavy heart. Cheongpung was twenty years old, and now that he had come down from the mountains, it was time for him to learn about the world one thing at a time.
hunks.sol: I continued with a heavy heart. Cheongpung was twenty years old. Now that he had come down from the mountains, it was time for him to learn about the world one thing at a time.

hunks.baseline: “There are three stages involved in having a child: ovulation, fertilization, and implantation. Try it.”
hunks.sol: “There are three stages involved in having a child: ovulation, fertilization, and implantation. Repeat after me.”

hunks.baseline: “Why would you do it with me? Are you insane? I said to repeat the words out loud.”
hunks.sol: “Why would you do it with me? Are you insane? I said repeat the words out loud.”

hunks.baseline: However, the sex education I had begun so ambitiously had to end the moment it started.
hunks.sol: However, my ambitious attempt at sex education had to end the moment it began.

hunks.baseline: “You bloody little bastards! How dare you behave like this in front of a great Senior of Murim!”
hunks.sol: “You little whelps! How dare you carry on like this in the presence of a great Senior of Murim!”

hunks.baseline: With help from the other two men officially known as the Three Hands of Zhongnan—but more accurately described as his lackeys—he had even had a splint attached. Now he glared at us.
hunks.sol: With help from the other two men officially known as the Three Hands of Zhongnan—but more accurately described as his lackeys—he had even gotten his arm splinted. Now he glared at us.

hunks.baseline: “A frontier bumpkin and a fool who acts tough because he trusts only his strength dare look down on a disciple of the great Zhongnan Sect?”
hunks.sol: “A frontier bumpkin and a fool who throws his weight around just because he’s strong dare look down on a disciple of the great Zhongnan Sect?”

hunks.baseline: “Thank you very much for telling me.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you so much for clearing that up.”

hunks.baseline: I let out a deep sigh. This man was old enough to know better, yet he still seemed unable to understand the situation. Was his background as a member of the Zhongnan Sect, and his faith in his father’s cousin, simply too strong?
hunks.sol: I let out a deep sigh. The man was old enough to know better, yet he still couldn’t read the situation. Was his faith in the Zhongnan Sect and his father’s cousin really that strong?

hunks.baseline: “Well, our Senior sure has a loose mouth.”
hunks.sol: “Our Senior sure has a reckless mouth.”

hunks.baseline: “Never mind me. What are you going to do if what this friend said is true?”
hunks.sol: “Forget about me. What are you going to do if what my friend said is true?”

hunks.baseline: Li Feng? Why was Li Feng being mentioned here?
hunks.sol: Li Feng? Why was Li Feng coming up now?

hunks.baseline: I looked at Li Feng, puzzled. He had gone rigid as though he had seen a ghost, but now he finally parted his lips.
hunks.sol: I looked at him in confusion. He had gone rigid as though he’d seen a ghost, but now he finally spoke.

hunks.baseline: “I am a lay disciple of Huashan. Until ten years ago, I was at the main sect.”
hunks.sol: “I am a lay disciple of Huashan. Until ten years ago, I lived at the main sect.”

hunks.baseline: Gong Ilhyuk added with a mocking grin,

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “That fellow was quite prominent among the lay disciples. At least, until he lost to me during a friendly duel with our sect. Isn’t that right?”
hunks.sol: Gong Ilhyuk added with a mocking grin, “That fellow was quite prominent among the lay disciples. At least, until he lost to me during a friendly duel with our sect. Isn’t that right?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s correct. I stayed at the Zhongnan Sect for two days for the duel, but I ate something bad and became seriously ill.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. I stayed at the Zhongnan Sect for two days for the duel, but I ate something bad and fell seriously ill.”

hunks.baseline: “Isn’t it a strange coincidence, no matter how often I think about it? Everyone who was scheduled to duel with you, myself included, suffered the same fate.”
hunks.sol: “Isn’t it a remarkable coincidence, no matter how often I think about it? Everyone scheduled to duel you, myself included, suffered the same fate.”

hunks.baseline: “……So you still can’t accept your defeat?”
hunks.sol: “…So you still can’t accept your defeat?”

hunks.baseline: “No. I accepted it a long time ago. In fact, thanks to you, I learned what Murim was like. As tuition, it was a cheap lesson.”
hunks.sol: “No. I accepted it long ago. In fact, thanks to you, I learned what Murim was really like. As tuition goes, it was a cheap lesson.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. You ran out of Huashan less than two months after our duel. What excuse are you going to make now?”
hunks.sol: “Of course. You ran away from Huashan less than two months after our duel. What excuse are you going to make now?”

hunks.baseline: “It had been about a month since that day. My Master suddenly told me that there was somewhere we had to go. When we arrived, all the leaders of our sect, including the Sect Leader, were gathered there.”
hunks.sol: “It was about a month after that day. My Master suddenly said he had somewhere to go. When I followed him there, I found all the leaders of our sect gathered together, including the Sect Leader.”

hunks.baseline: “It is a generous sect. After all, they let a failure like me join them on an important visit to see our Grandmaster.”
hunks.sol: “It is a generous sect. After all, they allowed a failure like me to accompany them on an important visit to see our Grandmaster.”

hunks.baseline: “There is only one Grandmaster in our sect. Sword Saint Mae Jonghak. The one everyone knows.”
hunks.sol: “There is only one Grandmaster in our sect. Sword Saint Mae Jonghak. The man everyone knows.”

hunks.baseline: Gasps rose from several places around the hall. Meanwhile, growing unease spread across Gong Ilhyuk’s face.
hunks.sol: Gasps rose from around the hall. Meanwhile, unease spread across Gong Ilhyuk’s face.

hunks.baseline: “That’s impossible. I heard the Sword Saint hadn’t shown himself in a long time…”
hunks.sol: “That’s impossible. I heard the Sword Saint hadn’t shown himself in years…”

hunks.baseline: “It’s true. However, he was still living at Huashan. He had simply gone into such deep seclusion that we hadn’t been able to find him.”
hunks.sol: “That’s true. But he was still on Huashan. His seclusion was simply so deep that we hadn’t been able to find him.”

hunks.baseline: “We combed through Huashan from top to bottom. We had to break through ten formations before we could reach his residence. Can you guess what I saw there?”
hunks.sol: “We combed through Huashan from top to bottom. Only after breaking through ten formations did we reach his residence. Can you guess what I saw there?”

hunks.baseline: “A cute little boy. He was much smaller than the other children his age, but he was diligently swinging a sword… No one could laugh. Who could laugh after seeing a monster perform the Plum Blossom Sword Technique at the age of ten?”
hunks.sol: “A cute little boy. He was much smaller than other children his age, but he was diligently swinging a sword… No one could laugh. Who could laugh after seeing a monster perform the Plum Blossom Sword Technique at the age of ten?”

hunks.baseline: “Unimaginable things sometimes happen in Murim. Compared to that, pulling dirty tricks in a friendly duel is nothing.”
hunks.sol: “Unimaginable things sometimes happen in Murim. Compared to that, rigging a friendly duel is nothing.”

hunks.baseline: “After more than a month of facing the wall in training, I came to a realization. I had no reason to remain there. That was why I left Huashan. What do you think? Isn’t it interesting?”
hunks.sol: “After more than a month of facing the wall in training, I came to a realization. I had no reason to remain there. That was why I left Huashan. What do you think? Isn’t it amusing?”

hunks.baseline: The story Li Feng told had a powerful impact. Everyone, myself included, stared silently at Cheongpung.
hunks.sol: Li Feng’s story hit hard. Everyone, myself included, stared silently at Cheongpung.

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, I remembered the conversation I had shared with him at Honghwa Inn the night before.
hunks.sol: Suddenly, I remembered the conversation I’d had with him at Honghwa Inn the night before.

hunks.baseline: *“I was ten years old. One day, dozens of people came barging in and made a scene. I remember my grandfather shouting at them to get the hell out before he set fire to the mountain.”*
hunks.sol: *“I was ten years old. One day, dozens of people came barging in and caused a scene. I remember my grandfather shouting at them to get lost before he set fire to the mountain.”*

hunks.baseline: Until then, I hadn’t known that the people who had come to cause trouble ten years ago were the leaders of Huashan, or that the Sword Saint Mae Jonghak was Cheongpung’s grandfather.
hunks.sol: At the time, I hadn’t realized that the people who had come to cause trouble ten years ago were Huashan’s leaders, or that Sword Saint Mae Jonghak was Cheongpung’s grandfather.

hunks.baseline: And the part about them making a scene was only how it had appeared from young Cheongpung’s perspective. The reality had probably been very different.
hunks.sol: And “caused a scene” was only how it had looked to young Cheongpung. The reality had probably been very different.

hunks.baseline: *Who would cause trouble with the Sword Saint? That’s a perfect way to get yourself killed.*
hunks.sol: *Who would cause trouble for the Sword Saint? That’s a perfect way to get yourself killed.*

hunks.baseline: The Sword Saint who had threatened to set fire to his own sect wasn’t exactly ordinary, either.
hunks.sol: Then again, the Sword Saint threatening to set fire to his own sect wasn’t exactly normal, either.

hunks.baseline: There were countless people who couldn’t reach First Rate even after turning twenty.
hunks.sol: Countless people failed to reach First Rate even after turning twenty.

hunks.baseline: Two of the rising martial artists from the Five Gates of Shanxi present here still weren’t quite good enough to be called First Rate masters.
hunks.sol: Two of the rising martial artists from the Five Gates of Shanxi present here still fell short of being called First Rate masters.

hunks.baseline: The moment that question occurred to me, Gong Ilhyuk shouted as though suffering a fit.
hunks.sol: The moment that question occurred to me, Gong Ilhyuk shouted as though having a fit.

hunks.baseline: The rising martial artists of the Five Gates of Shanxi who had been trying desperately to curry favor, Hong Jin, who had been watching with great interest, and even the other two members of the Three Hands of Zhongnan all frowned as though they had planned it together.
hunks.sol: The rising martial artists of the Five Gates of Shanxi who had been desperately trying to curry favor, Hong Jin, who had been watching with great interest, and even the other two members of the Three Hands of Zhongnan all frowned in unison.

hunks.baseline: “There’s no proof. All I have is my memory.”
hunks.sol: “There is no proof. All I have is my memory.”

hunks.baseline: “Exactly. Mountains and rivers change in ten years. Should I really trust your paltry memory?”
hunks.sol: “Exactly. Mountains and rivers can change in ten years. Why should I trust your paltry memory?”

hunks.baseline: “No. To be honest, I’m not certain either. I don’t know how that child grew up.”
hunks.sol: “No. To be honest, I’m not certain either. I don’t know what that child looks like now that he’s grown.”

hunks.baseline: He studied the blade, which radiated a cold chill, and asked Cheongpung,
hunks.sol: He studied the blade as it radiated a cold chill, then asked Cheongpung, “Young Hero, how much do you know about Huashan’s martial arts?”

hunks.baseline: “Young Hero. How much do you know about Huashan’s martial arts?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. My grandfather just taught me various things, saying they would be good to learn.”
hunks.sol: “No. My grandfather just taught me various things because he said they would be good to learn.”

hunks.baseline: “Then allow me to ask you something. Of the Six Harmonies Sword, Plum Blossom Sword Technique, Supreme Clarity Sword, Taeeul Miri Palm, Falling Flower Chasing Shadow Palm, and Scattering Flowers Shadowless Hand… how many do you know?”
hunks.sol: “Then allow me to ask. Of the Six Harmonies Sword, Plum Blossom Sword Technique, Supreme Clarity Sword, Taeeul Miri Palm, Falling Flower Chasing Shadow Palm, and Scattering Flowers Shadowless Hand… how many do you know?”

hunks.baseline: Li Feng gave a hollow laugh and handed the sword he was holding to Cheongpung.
hunks.sol: Li Feng gave a hollow laugh and handed his sword to Cheongpung.

hunks.baseline: “One form—or rather, a single sword stroke—will be enough.”
hunks.sol: “One form—no, a single sword stroke will suffice.”

hunks.baseline: After hesitating for a moment, Cheongpung took hold of the hilt.
hunks.sol: After hesitating, Cheongpung took hold of the hilt.

hunks.baseline: “Then I’ll show you briefly.”
hunks.sol: “Then I’ll give you a quick demonstration.”

hunks.baseline: From Cheongpung’s head to his toes, tangible strands of purple qi flowed from his entire body.
hunks.sol: Tangible strands of purple qi flowed from Cheongpung’s entire body, from head to toe.

hunks.baseline: It was Extreme Yang internal energy so potent that merely being near it scorched the breath in one’s lungs.
hunks.sol: It was Extreme Yang internal energy so potent that merely standing nearby felt as though it would scorch the breath in one’s lungs.

hunks.baseline: “Zaha Divine Technique[^2]…!”
hunks.sol: “The Zaha Divine Technique…!”

hunks.baseline: Like plum blossoms falling at the end of the season, a single streak of Sword Energy cleaved the enormous table in half.
hunks.sol: Like plum blossoms falling at the end of the season, a single streak of Sword Energy cleaved the enormous table in half—food, dishes, sturdy wood, and all.

hunks.baseline: The food, the dishes, even the sturdy table.
Breaking things was easy. But Cheongpung’s Sword Energy was so sharp and clean that, if the table hadn’t collapsed a moment later, no one would have noticed it had been cut.
hunks.sol: Breaking something was easy. But Cheongpung’s Sword Energy was so sharp and clean that if the table hadn’t collapsed a moment later, no one would have realized it had been cut.
